description: Do steps on the Simulator in order and get back what changed. Steps: tap #id | tap "label" | tap @x,y | fill #id text | type text | scroll down | swipe left ["row"] | hold "label" [seconds] | set #slider 0-100 | back | home | key return | wait "text" [seconds] | gone "text". Text in any language can be typed and is read back; a tap that changes nothing is reported; the first failing step stops the rest.

device.description: Name or UDID; default: the one in use

steps.description: One step per item, in the words ui_look prints
